findings.text: blocking: test_an_archived_origin_does_not_satisfy_the_compose_time_requirement duplicates test_composition_requires_an_explicit_current_origin at tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:198, which already pins the same refusal at the reviewed base; imas_codex/cli/sn.py:8424 never reads the archived properties origin, so composing from a catalog_edit archive reaches the identical origin-is-None branch and the archived value adds no coverage.

blocking: test_the_cli_requires_the_signer_to_state_the_origin duplicates test_cli_compose_requires_an_origin at tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:398, which already invokes sn restore compose on an extraction carrying origin catalog_edit with no --origin and asserts exit code 2 with --origin named in the output.

blocking: test_a_stated_origin_still_replaces_the_archived_one duplicates test_composition_replaces_archived_origin_with_the_stated_origin at tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:188, which already states origin pipeline over an archive carrying catalog_edit and asserts the composed node origin is pipeline.

follow-on: _extraction_carrying_origin forks the _extraction factory at tests/standard_names/test_archive_reconstruction_entry_point.py:41 for the same synthetic record shape, so the new module carries a second copy of a fixture its owner already parameterised by origin.
